title: Windows: keep the logon account for Entra ID and domain users
goal: The task user names the account that runs the service for Entra ID (AzureAD) and domain sessions too, not only local accounts
acceptance: Test committed failing first: with USERDOMAIN=AzureAD and no USERDNSDOMAIN, windowsServiceUser keeps AzureAD\\user; a domain user whose SSH session lacks USERDNSDOMAIN keeps USERDOMAIN\\user; WORKGROUP or empty USERDOMAIN still gives COMPUTERNAME\\user
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-20: narrow the account rule (keep USERDOMAIN unless WORKGROUP or empty, or ask the OS) and extend the B-082 test. Not a measurement.
